name: Anthropology PhD (including Biological Anthropology)
summary: Anthropology doctorate including biological anthropology research in human and primate evolution, functional anatomy, biological diversity and ecology.
detailsNote: Biological Anthropology is a subfield of the Anthropology PhD,not a separately verified application. The admission model was not established from the opened official sources. Department programme page could not be opened; GSAS programme profile and central requirements used.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application
deadlines.note: Current central dates list Anthropology. A combined degree uses the earlier partner deadline or December15,whichever comes first.

applicationFee.note: Non-US citizens explicitly eligible. Financial-hardship or qualifying affiliation requests require supporting documentation through a separate account-linked form; allow2–3businessdays. Request well before programme deadline; final form availability January2 is not permission to miss December15. Do not pay before decision; no refunds.

english.note: TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic for most non-native English speakers; no programme numeric minimum established. Exemption:English-primary undergraduate degree with at least three years in residence,or native English. Advanced degree alone does not exempt. Official electronic scores required; IELTS General,Online,One Skill Retake and paper reports excluded. Exempt applicants who self-report scores must send official verification.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from all attended colleges/universities
requirements.note: Bachelor-equivalent degree completed before matriculation; master not generally required. Writing sample explicitly required by Anthropology; no length limit inferred.

funding.note: Central policy states every PhD student receives tuition fellowship,living stipend and paid health coverage. Funding normally at least five years,with programme-specific terms; no numerical Fall2027 stipend inferred.
